Reject any path outside the inclusion list.

Compare final candidate against the approved path set and target tree.
Keep final merge, push, Pages publication, deployment, and release behind separate human approval.

decision.question: Authorize clean isolated candidate construction under this exact scope?
decision.approvalBasis: The user explicitly instructed implementation while reproducing the exact revision-36 candidate scope and later approval boundaries.

defaultBranchIntegration.requestedDecision: Authorize the exact validated candidate for conditional fast-forward integration into the remote default branch.

controlCheckpoint.rule: After the decision is recorded, refresh these four already-approved mutable paths once, freeze all 52 paths, and reject every new path or unrelated change. Later control events remain local until a separate checkpoint.

authorizedIfApproved: Record this decision against the pinned scope digest.
Refresh only the four listed mutable control paths inside the existing 52-path candidate.
Recompute all 52 candidate hashes and require the path set to remain exact.
Rerun check, integration, scale, simulation, build, privacy, secret, and diff validation.
Create one local commit with message chore: reconcile NexusCentral V2 durable work.
Re-read the live remote default ref and stop if it differs from the pinned target.
Push the validated commit to refs/heads/main only as a fast-forward.
Verify the remote commit and tree after the push.
notAuthorized: Add or remove any candidate path.
Force-push, rewrite history, merge gh-pages, or modify the original dirty worktree.
Publish Pages, deploy, release, use credentials, or invoke live model providers.
